dct_description_sm: These data comprise previously published and additional CTD rosette bottle data including PO₄, Si(OH)₄, NH₃, NO₂, NO₃, δ¹⁸O, δ²H, TA and tCO₂ measurements obtained during the NorthGreen2017 cruise from 11 September 2017 to 1 October 2017. The cruises were part of ongoing research into understanding the interaction between water masses and biogeochemistry on the Northeast Greenland shelf. Where necessary (e.g. tCO₂) samples were spiked with HgCl to eliminate biological changes in the sample. Samples were stored in the dark until analysed.

dct_title_s: Additional bottle chemistry values (ta, tco2, stable water isotopes, nutrients) for the NorthGreen2017 cruise on the Northeast Greenland Shelf, August-September 2017
